evals.prompt: I have a .NET 8 solution with two projects — a web API in src/Api and a class library in src/Core. I want a psakefile that restores, builds in Release mode, runs all xUnit tests with a TRX report, and packs NuGet packages. The version should come from an environment variable $env:BUILD_VERSION or default to '0.0.1'. Also I heard psake v5 has caching now — I want the Build task to be cached so repeat builds are fast during development.
evals.expected_output: A psakefile.ps1 with Version 5 declaration, Properties block, Build task using declarative syntax with Inputs/Outputs for caching (glob patterns for .cs/.csproj as inputs, .dll as outputs), and remaining tasks (Clean, Restore, Test, Pack) using standard syntax. All external commands wrapped in exec {}.

assertions.name: has_version_declaration
assertions.description: Build script should pin to psake v5

assertions.name: has_caching_inputs
assertions.description: Build task should define Inputs for caching

assertions.name: has_caching_outputs
assertions.description: Build task should define Outputs for caching

assertions.name: uses_exec
assertions.description: External commands should be wrapped in exec

assertions.name: has_version_fallback
assertions.description: Version should use env var with fallback

evals.prompt: I've been using psake v4 for years and now I want to upgrade my build to v5. Here's my existing psakefile.ps1 — it uses the old default.ps1 naming, has a custom outputHandler in psake-config.ps1, and uses Framework '3.5'. I need to know what to change and I want to take advantage of the new caching feature for my Compile task. Can you walk me through the migration and produce an updated psakefile?
evals.expected_output: Migration guidance covering: rename default.ps1 to psakefile.ps1, remove output handler config and use -OutputFormat instead, update Framework from 3.5 to 4.0+, add Version 5 declaration. Updated psakefile with Inputs/Outputs on the Compile task for caching.

assertions.name: mentions_rename
assertions.description: Should mention renaming default.ps1 to psakefile.ps1

assertions.name: has_caching_on_compile
assertions.description: Should add caching to the Compile task

evals.prompt: I'm setting up a GitHub Actions workflow for my PowerShell project that uses psake. I want the CI to validate the build plan first (catch circular deps before running), then run the build, and output the results as JSON for a downstream reporting step. If any task fails I need the error details from the structured result. Show me the psakefile and the GitHub Actions YAML.
evals.expected_output: A psakefile.ps1 with Version 5 and standard tasks. GitHub Actions YAML that uses Get-PsakeBuildPlan to validate the plan first, then Invoke-psake with -OutputFormat JSON or -Quiet to capture PsakeBuildResult, checks $result.Success, and uses the structured error info.

assertions.name: has_build_plan_validation
assertions.description: Should validate build plan before execution

assertions.name: has_structured_output
assertions.description: Should use structured output or JSON format

assertions.name: has_github_actions_yaml
assertions.description: Should include GitHub Actions workflow YAML

assertions.name: has_error_handling
assertions.description: Should handle build failures with error details
